title: 2895. Minimum Processing Time

examples.explanation: Assign the tasks at indices 4, 5, 6, 7 to the first processor which becomes available at time = 8, and the tasks at indices 0, 1, 2, 3 to the second processor which becomes available at time = 10. The time taken by the first processor to finish the execution of all tasks is max(8 + 8, 8 + 7, 8 + 4, 8 + 5) = 16. The time taken by the second processor to finish the execution of all tasks is max(10 + 2, 10 + 2, 10 + 3, 10 + 1) = 13.

Assign the tasks at indices 1, 4, 5, 6 to the first processor and the others to the second processor. The time taken by the first processor to finish the execution of all tasks is max(10 + 3, 10 + 5, 10 + 8, 10 + 4) = 18. The time taken by the second processor to finish the execution of all tasks is max(20 + 2, 20 + 1, 20 + 2, 20 + 3) = 23.
